kr.label: 대한민국 · KOSHA H-80-2021
kr.noteKo: 대한민국 사전검토 프로필입니다. 현재 체적 10배·작업 중 20회/h 기본값을 사용하되, 최신 법령·KOSHA GUIDE와 사업장 작업허가 절차를 반드시 대조하십시오.
kr.noteEn: Korea planning profile. The current defaults are 10 space volumes for initial purge and 20 ACH during work. Verify current law, KOSHA guidance and company procedures.
kr.source: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제618~625조 / KOSHA GUIDE H-80-2021
kr.approvalNote: 공식 출처 기반 사전검토 데이터이며, 사업장 현지 EHS의 승인·적용 판단은 별도 필요
rows: Initial ≥10× volume · During work ≥20 ACH (KOSHA GUIDE H-80-2021)
kr.clauses: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제618~625조 · KOSHA GUIDE H-80-2021

us-general.label: United States · OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146
us-general.noteKo: 미국 일반산업 허가필요 밀폐공간 프로필입니다. OSHA 1910.146은 이 도구의 10배·20 ACH를 법정값으로 정하지 않습니다. 사업장 위험평가·공학 기준을 입력하고 진입 전 및 작업 중 허용조건을 시험·감시하십시오.
us-general.noteEn: US general-industry permit-space profile. OSHA 1910.146 does not make this tool’s 10-volume or 20-ACH defaults a legal requirement. Use site engineering criteria and test/monitor acceptable entry conditions.
us-general.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: O₂ → flammable gases/vapors → potential toxic contaminants
No universal statutory ACH; verify acceptable entry conditions by testing and monitoring

us-construction.label: United States · OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart AA
us-construction.noteKo: 미국 건설업 밀폐공간 프로필입니다. 고정 환기배수 대신 현장 위험평가, 허가공간 프로그램, 격리, 시험·감시 및 구조계획을 우선 적용하십시오.
us-construction.noteEn: US construction confined-space profile. Apply the site hazard evaluation, permit-space program, isolation, testing/monitoring and rescue provisions; no fixed ACH is inferred here.
us-construction.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: Continuous monitoring unless employer demonstrates periodic monitoring is sufficient
No universal statutory ACH; permit-space program and verified entry conditions govern

uk.label: United Kingdom · Confined Spaces Regulations 1997 / HSE L101
uk.noteKo: 영국 프로필입니다. 가능한 경우 밀폐공간 진입을 피하고, 불가피한 진입에는 위험성평가에 따른 안전작업체계와 작업 전 비상조치를 적용하십시오. 이 프로필은 고정 ACH를 법정값으로 제시하지 않습니다.
uk.noteEn: United Kingdom profile. Avoid confined-space entry where possible; where entry is unavoidable, use a risk-assessed safe system of work and make adequate emergency arrangements before work starts. No fixed ACH is inferred.
uk.source: UK Confined Spaces Regulations 1997 / HSE ACOP L101
uk.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: Normal air ≈20.8 vol%; no single universal statutory entry band
DSEAR risk assessment and safe system of work
Suitable and sufficient arrangements before work starts
uk.clauses: Confined Spaces Regulations 1997, Reg. 4–5 · HSE ACOP L101

au.label: Australia · WHS Regulations / Model Code of Practice
au.scope: Australia model framework; state/territory confirmation required
au.noteKo: 호주 모델 기준 프로필입니다. 위험성평가·진입허가·격리·대기검사·감시·비상절차를 적용하십시오. Model Code의 법적 효력과 세부 요구사항은 해당 주·준주 규제기관에서 다시 확인해야 합니다.
au.noteEn: Australian model profile. Apply risk assessment, entry permit, isolation, atmospheric testing/monitoring and emergency procedures. Confirm the Code’s legal effect and local requirements with the relevant state or territory regulator.
au.source: Safe Work Australia Model Code of Practice: Confined spaces
au.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: Target <5% LEL · 5–<10% requires calibrated continuous detector/withdrawal · ≥10% withdraw immediately
Do not use pure oxygen or gas mixture >21% O₂
Confirm adoption and current requirements with the state/territory regulator
au.clauses: Model WHS Regulations 66–72 · Safe Work Australia Model Code, Nov 2024

sg.label: Singapore · WSH (Confined Spaces) Regulations 2009
sg.noteKo: 싱가포르 프로필입니다. 진입허가, 안전평가자의 가스검사, 환기, 작업 중 감시·주기시험, 훈련된 감시인과 구조계획을 적용하십시오. 산소 19.5~23.5%, 가연성 10% LEL 미만 및 물질별 노출기준을 확인합니다.
sg.noteEn: Singapore profile. Apply entry permits, gas testing by a confined-space safety assessor, ventilation, monitoring/periodic testing, a trained attendant and rescue planning. Check oxygen 19.5–23.5%, flammables below 10% LEL and applicable toxic exposure limits.
sg.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: Gas test by safety assessor and approval by authorised manager
Maintain ventilation; monitor and periodically retest during work

jp.label: Japan · Oxygen Deficiency Prevention Regulation
jp.noteKo: 일본 산소결핍 위험작업 사전검토 프로필입니다. 작업 전 산소(해당 시 황화수소)를 측정·기록하고, 작업 중 산소 18% 이상 및 제2종 작업의 황화수소 10 ppm 이하를 유지하도록 환기하십시오. 고정 ACH는 법정값으로 추정하지 않습니다.
jp.noteEn: Japan planning profile for oxygen-deficiency hazardous work. Measure and record oxygen (and H₂S where applicable) before work; ventilate to maintain oxygen at or above 18% and H₂S at or below 10 ppm for second-class work. No fixed ACH is inferred.
jp.source: Japan MHLW: Ordinance on Prevention of Oxygen Deficiency etc.
jp.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: Measure O₂; for second-class work, measure O₂ and H₂S before each day’s work
Record time, method, place, conditions, result, measurer and corrective measures; retain 3 years
Maintain O₂ ≥18%; for applicable second-class work also maintain H₂S ≤10 ppm

br.label: Brazil · NR-33 Confined Spaces
br.noteKo: 브라질 밀폐공간 사전검토 프로필입니다. NR-33에 따른 위험관리, 출입·작업허가(PET), 대기 조건 확인 및 비상대응 체계를 적용하십시오. 산소 20.9% 미만은 결핍, 23% 초과는 과잉으로 정의됩니다. 고정 ACH나 가연성 수치를 이 도구가 법정값으로 추정하지 않습니다.
br.noteEn: Brazil planning profile. Apply NR-33 risk management, entry-and-work permit (PET), atmospheric-condition checks and emergency arrangements. Oxygen below 20.9% is deficient and above 23% is enriched. This tool does not infer a statutory fixed ACH or flammable threshold.
br.source: Brazil Ministry of Labour and Employment: NR-33
br.approvalNote: Official-source planning data only; local site EHS approval and applicability review remain required.
rows: PET (Permissão de Entrada e Trabalho) for confined-space work
Apply NR-01 occupational risk-management programme to confined spaces
Verify acceptable conditions before and throughout entry/work; control toxic and flammable hazards

unverified.label: Unverified local jurisdiction · local EHS review required
unverified.scope: No verified local legal profile is supplied by this tool
unverified.noteKo: 현지 법규 프로필 미검증 — 회사 절차 및 현지 EHS 검토가 필수입니다. 이 도구의 수치·안내를 현지 법적 기준으로 사용하지 마십시오.
unverified.noteEn: Local legal profile is unverified. Company procedure and local EHS review are mandatory. Do not treat this tool’s figures or guidance as local legal criteria.
unverified.approvalNote: No local legal research or local EHS approval is supplied by this tool.
rows: Apply company procedure and obtain local EHS review before use
Set acceptable conditions from applicable local law, SDS and work permit
Use a documented engineering basis and verify by testing/monitoring
